svg.text: Character pawn-plus · animation-safe silhouette proof v2
REVIEW ONLY · one fixed head and palette · candidate parts are process-local · production art remains untouched
no legs, feet, or gait cycle
south + east · west mirrors east · north deferred
Body envelope check · same round head · no hair · no pose arms · 40 px
The body layer stays a single rigid mass; the procedural pose layer supplies every visible arm.
The repeated Column body in Twin Mass and Crest is intentional: head anchors must create identity without bespoke anatomy.
